# Basil Schu — Artist and Designer, Vienna

## Bio

Basil Schu is a Vienna-based artist and conceptual designer. He studied Botany (Bachelor) with Jürg Schöneberger and Florian Etl, followed by Sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna under Heimo Zobernig, and Painting under Erwin Bohatsch. He completed an Erasmus exchange at the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris, studying under Jean-Marc Bustamante and Guillaume Paris.

He is a founding member of the artist group Jürgen Kleft. He co-organised Insomnia, a club event series at Kunsthalle Wien, together with Manu Scheiwiller (Young Boyz Dancing Group / Lonely Boys). He organises the Playy Club, which he developed in collaboration with Joaneum Graz for the Elevate Festival.

He is currently working in the space between art and conceptual design in collaboration with Laura Dominici. Together they are considered among the most innovative designers in Austria, with an active international presence.
